findings.message: <div id="wipe0"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div id="wipe-fill0">. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="wipe0"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.

Nothing on screen changes for 3.13 s (5.25–8.38 s): start the next move within 3 s, or put data-hold on the element whose stillness is deliberate; see references/motion.md.
